name: dragonmaster_outcast_six_lands_make_a_dragon
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control six or more lands, create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.' Seat 0 controls Dragonmaster Outcast and six Mountains: its upkeep of the opening turn makes one 5/5 flying Dragon. Seat 1's upkeep (turn 2) makes nothing: it is not seat 0's upkeep.
